description: Per-call cost estimate for the AI path. AI-side unit prices are real, dated, and sourced. The human-agent comparison reuses config/manual_baseline.json's handle-time figures but needs a real fully-loaded hourly labour cost from CIMET before it means anything - that one number is a placeholder, everything else here is a cited rate times a stated assumption.

llm.rate_source_model: Qwen3 32B on Groq (closest publicly-priced model to the one actually used - Groq does not publish a rate for qwen3.8-27b specifically, so this is a stand-in, not a confirmed quote)

assumed_tokens_per_call.basis: an 8-field Energy recovery conversation, ~10-15 turns - an estimate, not a measurement

human_side.fully_loaded_hourly_cost_usd: PLACEHOLDER - CIMET's real fully-loaded agent cost (wages + overhead) has not been supplied. Do not quote a dollar comparison to judges until this is a real number.
